learning_outcomes.text: He/she can express himself/herself clearly and understandably by paying attention to speech disorders.
He/she knows the sound characteristics of his/her language and can express his/her language accordingly.
He/she knows the composition formation information and can create a written composition accordingly.
He/she can examine the written expression types and write written types such as essay, petition.
He/she knows the beautiful and effective speaking methods and can speak accordingly.
He/she knows the oral expression types such as conference, panel, panel discussion, symposium.
He/she can make seminar presentations in his/her field.

assessment_rules: The final success grade is determined by the contribution of the in-term activities and final exam grade. The midterm examination contributes 40% to the final grade, and the final examination contributes 60%.
